issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) semantics change may break absolute or protocol-prefixed source URLs
issues.detail: The change from resolve(s || '', from) to resolve(from, '..', s || '') alters how source paths are resolved. If `s` is an absolute path or URL (http://, webpack://, file://), pathe.resolve will still treat it as absolute in some cases but the '..' segment introduces an extra parent-directory hop relative to `from` instead of treating `from` as a base file. Sources referencing files outside `from`'s directory (common with `../../src`) now resolve relative to from's parent rather than from itself — worth verifying against URL-style sources.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside getSourceMap callback blocks event loop per stack frame
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called for every frame during error reporting. Each external frame triggers existsSync + readFileSync on potentially large bundled files (and possibly a second readFileSync for an external .map). No caching is applied, so the same external file is re-read for every frame in the stack. Consider memoizing by `file` for the duration of a single parseErrorStacktrace call.

issues.description: Returning '{}' as fallback source map content may produce misleading mappings
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file doesn't exist, createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the string '{}'. convert-source-map will parse this as a valid but empty source map, which may then be used by trace-mapping and silently produce no mapping rather than signalling failure. Returning undefined or throwing might be safer; verify convert-source-map's contract for the readMap callback.

issues.description: Mixed use of pathe and node:path could cause cross-platform inconsistency
issues.detail: The file imports `resolve` from 'pathe' but introduces `import path from 'node:path'` and uses path.resolve/path.dirname in the new helpers. On Windows these can return backslash-separated paths, whereas Vite/Vitest tends to normalize to forward slashes via pathe. Using pathe consistently would keep behavior aligned with the rest of the module graph keys.

issues.description: convert-source-map default import may need esModuleInterop or namespace import
issues.detail: `import convertSourceMap from 'convert-source-map'` works only if esModuleInterop/allowSyntheticDefaultImports is enabled or if the package ships a default export. convert-source-map is a CommonJS module exporting named functions; depending on TS config and bundler this default import may resolve to `undefined.fromSource`. Verify build output or use `import * as convertSourceMap`.

issues.description: SourceMap type imported from 'rollup' for a non-rollup code path
issues.detail: The new helper returns `SourceMap | undefined` using rollup's SourceMap type, but the map originates from convert-source-map's `.toObject()` and is consumed by parseErrorStacktrace's getSourceMap hook. Rollup's SourceMap shape may not exactly match what's returned (e.g. mappings as string vs decoded). A more local/structural type or @jridgewell type would be more accurate.

review.summary: The PR fixes source-map resolution for external module stack traces in two ways: corrects the resolvedSources base path in DecodedMap and adds an extractSourcemapFromFile hook in TestRun for external files. The core fix is reasonable and the snapshot update confirms it produces correct .ts line/column mapping. Main concerns are performance (no caching of readFileSync across frames), the '{}' fallback potentially masking missing maps, and minor type/import hygiene around convert-source-map and rollup's SourceMap type. The pathe-vs-node:path mix and the changed resolve() argument order also deserve a careful look for URL-form sources and Windows paths.
